title: Turn Claude Into Your Compliance Officer in 60 Seconds
description:
Comment "Safe" for the Compliance Ops skill pack

You're building with Claude Code in medical, legal, or finance.

One leaked record and you're sued or fined.

You can't bring AI agents in safely. So you sit frozen while competitors ship.

Compliance Ops fixes that.

It makes Claude aware of HIPAA, SOC 2, GDPR, PCI before it builds.

Loads the framework. Flags bad moves. Documents it.

A seatbelt, not a certificate. Not legal advice.
